subject: Post-demo: procurement eligibility, purchase path options & SOC 2 timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Nolan <j.nolan@lumatech.com>, procurement@lumatech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 3 Aug 2025 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: procurement eligibility, purchase path options & SOC 2 timeline

Thanks for taking the demo today — appreciate the time, James. Quick recap and next steps so your procurement and security teams have clear options: 

Key takeaways from the demo:
- Platform fit: Redwood can meet your latency and multi-tenant isolation asks with Dedicated capacity or Private VPC.
- Data controls: we support customer-managed KMS and audit logs; DPA available.
- Commercial paths: 1) self-serve card for POC, 2) paper PO/SOW for committed capacity, 3) cloud marketplace listing (Azure/GCP) if you prefer consolidated invoicing.

Ask list / next steps I promised to capture:
- Procurement: which path does Lumatech prefer for initial rollout (card vs PO vs marketplace)? Please indicate "short term" (PO or card) vs "enterprise/committed" (PO/SOW).
- Security: can you share the security questionnaire PDF (SOC 2/DPA questions) so we can map owners and timing?
- Timeline: what internal milestone drives the procurement decision (pilot start date / compliance review deadline)?

Attachments: none on this message — I will follow with a draft SOW and a short procurement checklist.

Planned owners: Marissa (contracts) + Karthik (security onboarding) are looped to help with timing and answers.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment placeholder: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist.pdf]

From: James Nolan <j.nolan@lumatech.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lumatech.com
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 09:01:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement eligibility, purchase path options & SOC 2 timeline

Thanks Marcus — good session. Quick answers and a few attachments from our side: 

Procurement preference
- For the pilot we prefer a credit card transaction (speed), but for production we'll need a PO + SOW (likely Q4 commit).

Security questionnaire
- Attached is our standard vendor security questionnaire (PDF). Expect InfoSec to review and come back with clarifying Qs.

Timeline
- Pilot start target: Sept 15 (engineering availability).
- Production procurement window: late Nov / early Dec (budget cycle).

Questions for you
1) If we start on card for the pilot and then switch to PO, what does the paperflow look like — do you roll prior usage into a committed PO or is there a clean break?
2) Any blockers for marketplace listing (we might prefer consolidated invoicing via our Azure marketplace account)?

Attached: Lumatech_Security_Questionnaire.pdf

—James
James Nolan
Senior Procurement Manager | LumaTech
j.nolan@lumatech.com
[Attachment: Lumatech_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Nolan <j.nolan@lumatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Aug 2025 12:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement eligibility, purchase path options & SOC 2 timeline

Great — thanks for the questionnaire, James. Quick responses inline and a short SOW draft attached: 

1) Card -> PO transition:
- Operationally: pilot on card is fine. We invoice card usage until PO effective date. For a committed PO we can do either: (a) apply a credit for pilot usage against the PO (requires explicit clause in SOW) or (b) treat pilot as separate and start fresh with the PO. We typically recommend (a) to avoid double-billing, but we leave the choice to customer.
- Action: Marissa can prepare a SOW template with an "apply credits" clause; should take ~2 business days once we confirm volumes.

2) Marketplace:
- We are live on Azure marketplace with metered billing; GCP is in preview. Marketplace onboarding takes ~2-3 weeks for Azure (procurement & legal signoffs on both sides). If you want consolidated billing on Azure, that is an option; it does add the marketplace fee layer — we can share a delta analysis.

Security & SOC 2:
- Karthik will own the SOC 2 evidence handoff and can provide our SOC 2 Type II report and DPA template. Expect 3–5 business days to collect and share artifacts once we confirm the specific sections you flagged in the questionnaire.

Attached: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx (SOW template with credit clause)

Next steps (proposed):
- James: confirm card pilot vs immediate PO decision (reply by EOD Wed 8/6)
- Marissa: will drop SOW + credit clause and PoC billing cadence
- Karthik: will send SOC 2 artifacts and mapping table to Lumatech security team by Tue 8/5

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if procurement wants to walk the options.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Draft_v1.docx]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: James Nolan <j.nolan@lumatech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 Aug 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: procurement eligibility, purchase path options & SOC 2 timeline

Hi James — Karthik from Redwood security. Short note on evidence and expected tempo: 

- SOC 2 artifacts: we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report (redacted), control matrix, and sample audit logs.
- DPA & security mapping: I'll map Lumatech's questionnaire to our artifacts and call out any gaps. If there are clarifying Qs from your InfoSec team, please mark them inside the PDF and I will respond line-by-line.
- Timing: target to share the mapping + artifacts by Tue 8/5 EOD PST. If your InfoSec wants deeper review (interview / walkthrough), we can schedule a 60-min session the week of Aug 11.

One quick note on procurement gating: most customers can proceed with a pilot on card while we complete security vetting; production cutover typically requires DPA and either SOC 2 evidence or compensating controls. Happy to align on the exact acceptance criteria you need.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com
